prompt: As of August 3rd 2024, how many countries are full members of the council that oversees the sport that Henry Simonds plays?
answer: As of August 3, 2024, **12 countries were full members of the International Cricket Council (ICC)**, the governing body for cricket—the sport played by Henry Simonds.
